rules.E164-P3: power int8: as P1, the 22 priority-1 int8 tiles (at least 6), card-1 int8 rows
rules.E164-B1: bias, floats: mean(D - M9) over the 26 priority-1 float tiles (at least 8) against the 2.5-97.5% range of the mean of as many draws (the same format mix) from the same errors: PASS inside, FAIL HIGH below it (M9 predicts too much), FAIL LOW above it
rules.E164-B2: bias, int8: as B1, the 22 priority-1 int8 tiles (at least 6)
rules.E164-C1: coverage, power: tiles inside M9's frozen 95% band among the 48 priority-1 tiles; PASS if at least the 2.5% point of Binomial(n, 0.95) (42 of 48), FAIL if fewer; NOT SCORED under 10
rules.E164-M1: M9 against M6 (rank 1's primary): d = rms(M9 errors) - rms(M6 errors) over the priority-1 tiles, 95% interval by a paired bootstrap over tiles (5,000 draws): BETTER ('resolved below zero') if the upper bound < 0, WORSE if the lower bound > 0, else NOT RESOLVED; card 1's half of 'on both 600 MHz cards' (E163 has aifoundry3's)
rules.E164-U1: M9 against M6 on the 12 unaimed tiles (blind7.json subsets.unaimed_synthetic, at least 10): the same paired bootstrap; PASS ('no worse') unless the 95% interval lies above zero (lower bound > 0: FAIL); d and its interval reported, and the same reading on the 17 (unaimed_with_float_real) beside, never a verdict
rules.E164-H1: heat fp32: rms(dT_win - M9's dT) over the priority-1 fp32 tiles (at least 6) against the 2.5-97.5% range of the rms of as many draws from a deterministic normal sample of 2,000 points with M9's carried card-1 heat rms for fp32: PASS at or below the 97.5% point, FAIL above
rules.E164-H4: coverage, heat: as C1, M9's frozen dT band (42 of 48)
